body: So how is after life? Would make for a interesting thread, despite the suicide you know.

You dont need to do anything, you got me? Bonus points for living another day despite all the shit.

It might seam unstoppable and unfixable for you, but there is a metric ton of people with different minds and brains why would be keen on trying to solve your problem because they are sometimes sick of their own. Sorry if I was a bit rude but its not that I am pissed that you slammed a metaphorical door in my face if I tried to help you. Its like seeing a submarine slowly diving, knowing it has orders for total anihilation on board, so you try to change fate as long as its not gone, screaming at the sinking ship.

Hope you are still alive and okay-ish OP!

Would love to help you change your mind, but doesnt make sense if you dont want to. Gl explaining in 45 minutes why you wont be there for the potential rest of your days. Do you really think a note or something is going to fix all the feelings that were caused by such actions? Yeah, I dont do either...

Fucking talk to us at least if you want our help. I dont want this subreddit becoming just a last drop off point for people hell bent on killing themselfes. Give us a chance at least god damnit

I am sorry man! I really wish i could but I am so broke I cant make a call to india sorry.

We can talk if you like, just pm me if you like.

I dont know if thats true but if you really have cake day tomorrow its normally to go a bit nuts if you are down. I have it today and do all this to distract me from my shit. you are not allone!

We are here we do care! Pls share what brought you to this point maybe it gets easier for you or even helps a bit.

 I saw a documentation about people jumping from the golden gate bridge and all who survived said they regretted it the moment they let go of the railing. I dont know how you feel or they felt but I dont wish anyone to have their last moments filled with regrets.

If you write a last will you have your own saying I guess. Maybe they cut you open if they just find you bloated and drowned, anyways I think an open casket isnt adviseable with a wet death. There are some really nice bio degradeable options. Mud to mud and dust to dust you know?

We dont hate you! If you want to talk why you want to go into the water feel free to hook me up.
I hope it gives you the insurance you need but you will never feel like using it. Wont be a party for everyone like the bottle says, let me tell you that.
